# Hotel booking: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Free cancellation must be offered up to 48 hours before arrival, under the Tourism Consumer Code. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a guest, I want to choose my room type so that I get the view I like.
US-2 As a guest, I want to cancel at no cost until two days before I arrive so that plans can change.
US-3 As a guest, I want to add breakfast to my booking so that it is sorted.
US-4 As a guest, I want a confirmation email so that I have the details.
constraints: Free cancellation must be offered up to 48 hours before arrival, under the Tourism Consumer Code.
